ud5.6:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
ud5.6:1.3: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Mahākaccāno Avantīsu viharati Kuraraghare Pavatte pabbate.
ud5.6:1.4: tena kho pana samayena Soṇo upāsako Koṭikaṇṇo āyasmato Mahākaccānassa upaṭṭhāko hoti.
ud5.6:2.1: atha kho Soṇassa upāsakassa koṭikaṇṇassa rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi:
ud5.6:2.2: yathā-yathā kho ayyo Mahākaccāno dhammaṃ deseti, na yidaṃ sukaraṃ agāraṃ ajjhāvasatā ekantaparipuṇṇaṃ ekantaparisuddhaṃ saṅkhalikhitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ carituṃ.
ud5.6:2.3: yannūn' āhaṃ kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajeyyan ti.
ud5.6:3.1: atha kho Soṇo upāsako Koṭikaṇṇo yen' āyasmā Mahākaccāno ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Mahākaccānaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi,
ud5.6:3.2: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho Soṇo upāsako Koṭikaṇṇo āyasmantaṃ Mahākaccānaṃ etad avoca:
ud5.6:5.1: evaṃ vutte āyasmā Mahākaccāno Soṇaṃ upāsakaṃ Koṭikaṇṇaṃ etad avoca:
ud5.6:5.2: dukkaraṃ kho Soṇa yāvajīvaṃ ekabhattaṃ ekaseyyaṃ brahmacariyaṃ,
ud5.6:5.3: iṅgha tvaṃ Soṇa tatth' eva agārikabhūto samāno buddhānaṃ sāsanaṃ anuyuñja kālayuttaṃ ekabhattaṃ ekaseyyaṃ brahmacariyan ti.
ud5.6:5.4: atha kho Soṇassa upāsakassa Koṭikaṇṇassa yo ahosi pabbajjābhisaṅkhāro, so paṭippassambhi.
ud5.6:6.1: dutiyam pi kho Soṇassa upāsakassa Koṭikaṇṇassa rahogatassa . . . pe . . .
ud5.6:6.2: pabbajeyyan ti. dutiyam pi kho Soṇo upāsako Koṭikaṇṇo yen' āyasmā . . . avoca: idha . . . pabbājetu maṃ bhante ayyo Mahākaccāno 'ti. dutiyaṃ pi kho āyasmā Mahākaccāno Soṇaṃ upāsakaṃ Koṭikaṇṇaṃ etad avoca:
ud5.6:6.3: dukkaraṃ . . . pe . . . brahmacariyan ti. dutiyam pi kho Soṇassa . . . pe . . .
ud5.6:7.4: tatiyam pi kho Soṇo upāsako Koṭikaṇṇo yen' āyasmā . . .
ud5.6:9.1: atha kho āyasmā Mahākaccāno Soṇaṃ upāsakam Koṭikaṇṇaṃ pabbājesi.
ud5.6:9.2: tena kho pana samayena Avantisudakkhiṇāpatho appabhikkhuko hoti.
ud5.6:9.3: atha kho āyasmā Mahākaccāno tiṇṇaṃ vassānaṃ accayena kicchena kasirena tato-tato dasavaggaṃ bhikkhusaṃghaṃ sannipātetvā āyasmantaṃ Soṇaṃ upasampādesi.
ud5.6:10.1: atha kho āyasmato Soṇassa vassaṃ vutthassa rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evañ cetaso parivitakko udapādi:
ud5.6:10.2: na kho me so bhagavā sammukhā diṭṭho api ca suto yeva me
ud5.6:10.4: sace maṃ upajjhāyo anujāneyya, gacchey' āhaṃ bhagavantaṃ dassanāya arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhan ti.
ud5.6:11.1: atha kho āyasmā Soṇo sāyaṇhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yen' āyasmā Mahākaccāno ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Mahākaccānaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi,
ud5.6:11.2: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Soṇo āyasmantaṃ Mahākaccānaṃ etad avoca:
ud5.6:12.4: sace maṃ upajjāyo anujāneyya, gaccheyy' āhaṃ bhagavantaṃ dassanāya arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhan ti.
ud5.6:13.2: gaccha tvaṃ Soṇa taṃ bhagavantaṃ dassanāya arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhan ti.
ud5.6:13.3: dakkhissasi tvaṃ Soṇa taṃ bhagavantaṃ pāsādikaṃ pāsādanīyaṃ santindriyaṃ santamānasaṃ uttamaṃ samathadamatham anuppattaṃ dantaṃ guttaṃ yatindriyaṃ nāgaṃ,
ud5.6:13.4: disvāna mama vacanena bhagavato pāde sirasā vandāhi, appābādhaṃ appātaṅkaṃ lahuṭṭhānaṃ balaṃ phāsuvihāraṃ puccha:
ud5.6:13.5: upajjhāyo me bhante āyasmā Mahākaccāno bhagavato pāde sirasā vandati, appābādhaṃ . . . pe . . . phāsuvihāraṃ pucchatī 'ti.
ud5.6:14.1: evam bhante 'ti kho āyasmā Soṇo āyasmato Mahākaccānassa bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā uṭṭhāy' āsanā āyasmantaṃ Mahākaccānaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā senāsanaṃ saṃsāmetvā pattacīvaram ādāya yena Sāvatthī tena cārikaṃ pakkāmi,
ud5.6:14.2: anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno yena Sāvatthī Jetavanaṃ Anāthapiṇḍikass' ārāmo, yena bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi,
ud5.6:14.3: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Soṇo bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
ud5.6:15.1: kacci bhikkhu khamanīyaṃ, kacci yāpanīyaṃ, kacci pi appakilamathena addhānaṃ āgato, na ca piṇḍakena kilanto sī 'ti.
ud5.6:15.2: khamanīyaṃ bhagavā, yāpanīyaṃ bhagavā, appakilamathena c' āhaṃ bhante addhānaṃ āgato, na ca piṇḍakena kilanto mhī 'ti.
ud5.6:16.1: atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ āmantesi:
ud5.6:16.2: imass' Ānanda āgantukassa bhikkhuno senāsanaṃ paññāpehī 'ti.
ud5.6:16.3: atha kho āyasmato Ānandassa etad ahosi:
ud5.6:16.5: imass' Ananda āgantukassa bhikkhuno senāsanaṃ paññāpehī 'ti icchati bhagavā tena bhikkhunā saddhiṃ ekavihāre vatthuṃ, icchati bhagavā āyasmatā Soṇena saddhiṃ ekavihāre vatthun ti
ud5.6:16.6: yasmiṃ vihāre bhagavā viharati, tasmiṃ vihāre āyasmato Soṇassa senāsanaṃ paṇṇāpesi.
ud5.6:17.1: atha kho bhagavā bahud eva rattiṃ abbhokāse nisajjāya vītināmetvā pāde pakkhāletvā vihāraṃ pāvisi,
ud5.6:17.2: āyasmā pi kho Soṇo bahud . . . pe . . . pāvisi.
ud5.6:17.3: atha kho bhagavā rattiyā paccūsasamayaṃ paccuṭṭhāya āyasmantaṃ Soṇaṃ ajjhesi:
ud5.6:17.4: patibhātu taṃ, bhikkhu dhammaṃ bhāsitun ti.
ud5.6:18.1: evaṃ bhante 'ti kho āyasmā Soṇo bhagavato paṭissutvā soḷasa aṭṭhakavaggikāni sabbān' eva sarena abhaṇi.
ud5.6:18.2: atha kho bhagavā āyasmato Soṇassa sarabhaññapariyosāne abbhanumodi:
ud5.6:18.3: sādhu sādhu bhikkhu, suggahitāni bhikkhu soḷasa aṭṭhakavaggikāni sumanasikatāni sūpadhāritāni; kalyāniyā si vācāya samannāgato vissaṭṭhāya aneḷagalāya atthassa viññāpaniyā.
ud5.6:18.6: kissa pana tvaṃ bhikkhu evaṃ ciraṃ akāsī 'ti.
ud5.6:18.7: ciraṃ diṭṭho me bhante kāmesu ādīnavo
ud5.6:18.8: api ca sambādho gharāvāso bahukicco bahukaraṇīyo 'ti.
ud5.6:19.1: atha kho bhagavā etam atthaṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi:
